# NuCraft (bundled)

Put the NuCraft source files here (`NuCraft.py` and any data files it ships with),
together with NuCraft's own license file. `scripts/install_nucraft.sh` installs them
into the `hep` environment.

These files are kept exactly as distributed. The NumPy 2 compatibility fix is applied
to the installed copy only, never to the files in this folder.

NuCraft: M. Wallraff and C. Wiebusch, Comput. Phys. Commun. 197 (2015) 185, arXiv:1409.1387.
